Loss report: forgejo -> drone

[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.action (input token has no Drone equivalent)

[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-3 step.action (no Drone mapping for action docker://alpine:3.20)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-3 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/local step.action (no Drone mapping for action ./.github/actions/setup)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/local step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.action: image selection (later steps without an image run in this image)
